location.ref: section on Īśvara (commentary on the maṅgala)

paraphrase: Earth, sprouts and the like have a maker, because they are effects, like a pot; (this establishes the Lord).
speaker: Viśvanātha
notes: The subject 'kṣityaṅkurādikam' of this inference in the Muktāvalī is confirmed by the local Subodhinī e-text; the wording of the inference is the standard one, from memory.
